args.query: cache FastAPI endpoint responses in Redis with TTL using redis.asyncio

results.title: requests-cache CachedSession with sqlite backend and expiry
results.summary: A requests session backed by a persistent sqlite cache with TTL expiry and 200-only caching, tested offline with responses mocks.

results.title: redis-py pipelines and WATCH transactions tested with fakeredis
results.summary: Batch commands with redis-py pipelines and guard optimistic WATCH/MULTI transactions, tested fully offline against a shared in-memory fakeredis server.

results.title: Celery 5 on Redis with fakeredis-backed idempotency, tested offline in eager mode
results.summary: Configure a Celery app on a Redis broker and result backend for production, guard a task with a Redis SET NX idempotency lock, and test it offline with task_always_eager and fakeredis.

results.title: FastAPI endpoints cached with cashews in-memory backend
results.summary: FastAPI routes backed by a cashews mem:// cache with key templates, TTL and explicit invalidation, tested fully offline through httpx ASGITransport.

results.title: lru-cache TTL eviction and size limits
results.summary: Cache computed values with lru-cache, covering max entries, TTL expiry via fake timers, and getOrSet style populate helpers offline.

results.title: FastAPI endpoint with Pydantic v2 discriminated unions and Annotated validators
results.summary: Accept a tagged union of payment methods with Field(discriminator), add Annotated validators, and test the exact 422 error shapes offline with TestClient.

results.title: FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy 2 on aiosqlite, tested offline with per-test in-memory DBs
results.summary: A FastAPI app using AsyncSession and async_sessionmaker on aiosqlite, tested with httpx.AsyncClient over ASGITransport, overriding the session dependency with a fresh in-memory database for each test.

results.title: FastAPI WebSockets with token auth and broadcast, tested with TestClient
results.summary: FastAPI WebSocket endpoint that authenticates via query token, rejects with a close code and broadcasts to connected clients; tested with TestClient.websocket_connect.

results.title: ioredis cache-aside with TTL, tested with ioredis-mock (Vitest)
results.summary: Cache-aside helper on ioredis with JSON values, TTLs, stampede-safe single flight and invalidation, tested offline with ioredis-mock in Vitest. Install uses --legacy-peer-deps because ioredis-mock 8 still peers on ioredis ^5, but the mock passes its tests against ioredis 6. vite is pinned so Vitest still resolves under legacy-peer-deps.

results.title: FastAPI metrics with prometheus_client scraped as text
results.summary: Instrument FastAPI with prometheus_client using a per-app registry, label by route template to bound cardinality, and scrape the text exposition format offline through httpx.ASGITransport.
